payload.body:
FOR hv, from utilz-vc, about the push of Utilz main (2.14.4).

What happened: 0112 (A4, use brew refuses and removes nothing when no Homebrew copy would answer) landed locally as b2e07f19 and checks GREEN. You are AFK, so molt-vc changed the order: the final-head checks (cc's Mac twins, dc's kovacs twins from a hash-checked bundle, dc's dry run) run on the landed local head, and the push waits for you.

What it changes from decision 60(2): CI reads main only after your push, not before the checks. So the cut also waits for CI to go green on the pushed head. A red there reopens its issue, as before.

The ask: when you are back, push main with
  ! git -C /Users/matts/Devel/prj/Utilz push upstream main
vc then watches CI on the pushed head. molt-vc puts this in front of you together with ready to cut.
